نظطلم (form VIII)
# نَظْطَلِمُ (naẓṭalimu) /naðˤ.tˤa.li.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# نَظْطَلِمَ (naẓṭalima) /naðˤ.tˤa.li.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
# نَظْطَلِمْ (naẓṭalim) /naðˤ.tˤa.lim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِظْطَلَمَ (iẓṭalama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
